qualifications: Eight whole libraries are the sampling unit; deterministic sectors, reversals, populations, probes, quadrature nodes and refinements add no independent draws.
Nominal t7 intervals are pointwise, with no calibrated or simultaneous coverage guarantee.
Tangent TIME and canonical endpoint are paired estimators of one linearized flow. Physical finite work uses separate finite trajectories and the shared tangent control.
Numerical, field, basis and Fourier-tail proxies are empirical assessments, not rigorous continuum bounds. No pending collective or autonomous calculation is promoted.
scope: Fixed-background prescribed finite quadrupolar cycle; full initial even DF and analytic current matching. No observed catalogue matching, collective qualification, autonomous acceleration or live-bar formation.
